meta.title: Offline boarding passes
meta.lede: Boarding passes that scan with no signal at the Brisk slipway, in seven steps across three phases. Approve each step with go, revise, or skip.

parts.markdown:
Brisk harbour has no mobile signal at the slipway on most mornings. Passes that need the network fail at the ramp, and crew fall back to a paper list printed the night before, which misses every late booking.

The goal is a pass the crew scanner can check with no network at all, in place for the winter timetable on 26 October.

spec.label: Offline for
spec.text: Up to eight hours, the first Brisk sailing to the last on a winter day.

spec.label: Check time
spec.text: Under one second a pass on the oldest handheld the crews carry.

spec.label: Copied passes
spec.text: Refused when scanned twice on one handheld, and flagged across handhelds once back in signal.

spec.label: Out of scope
spec.text: Wallet passes, paper tickets, and any change to fares or refunds.

parts.title: How a pass is signed and checked
parts.source:
flowchart TB
  keys[(Signing keys)]:::violet --> book[Booking service]
  book -->|signed pass| app[Rider app]
  app -->|QR code at the ramp| scanner[Crew scanner]:::accent
  keys -.->|public keys, nightly| scanner
  scanner -->|scans, once back in signal| log[(Boarding log)]:::teal

items.title: Add a pass signing key to the booking service
items.summary: An Ed25519 key pair in the secrets store, rotated every 90 days, with the old key accepted for a week after.

facets.label: What changes
facets.markdown: A key pair lives in the secrets store under `pass-signing`. The booking service loads it at startup and publishes the public half at `/keys/pass.json`.

facets.label: Done when
facets.markdown: `curl -s localhost:8080/keys/pass.json | jq '.keys | length'` prints 2 during a rotation and 1 otherwise.

facets.label: Risk
facets.markdown: A leaked private key lets anyone mint passes. An early rotation revokes it within the hour, and the runbook has the steps.

items.title: Sign every pass at booking
items.summary: Each pass carries its booking, sailing, party, and vehicle, signed, in a QR code the scanner reads in poor light.

facets.label: What changes
facets.markdown: The pass payload grows from a booking id to the fields below, signed and base45 encoded. Passes issued before the change work until they expire.

facets.label: Touches
facets.markdown: `booking/pass/issue.go`, the rider app's pass screen, and the confirmation email.

facets.label: Done when
facets.markdown: `go test ./booking/pass/...` passes, and a pass shown at 70% screen brightness scans on the oldest handheld.

facets.label: Diff

items.title: Keep the public keys on every scanner
items.summary: Scanners fetch the public keys whenever they have signal and keep the last two, so a rotation never strands a sailing.

facets.label: What changes
facets.markdown: The crew app fetches `/keys/pass.json` at launch and each night on harbour Wi-Fi, and stores the last two keys. The status bar shows how old they are.

facets.label: Done when
facets.markdown: With Wi-Fi off for 48 hours, a scanner still accepts passes signed before and after a rotation.

items.title: Check passes on the scanner with no network
items.summary: The scanner checks the signature, sailing, and expiry itself, and shows board or stop in under a second.

facets.label: What changes
facets.markdown: A scan checks the signature against the stored keys, then the sailing and expiry against the handheld's clock. The screen shows board in teal or stop in ochre, with the reason in words.

facets.label: Why
facets.markdown: Crew load forty cars in ten minutes at Brisk. Anything slower than a second a pass holds up the ramp.

facets.label: Done when
facets.markdown: `scanner-sim --offline 8h --passes testdata/brisk-week.json` reports every pass checked in under 1,000 ms.

facets.label: Risk
facets.markdown: A handheld with the wrong time refuses good passes. The scanner keeps the last server time it saw and warns crew when the clock drifts more than five minutes.

items.title: Queue scans until the signal returns
items.summary: Scans wait on the handheld and upload when it reconnects, and a pass scanned twice is flagged to the office.

facets.label: What changes
facets.markdown: Each scan goes into a local queue with the pass and the time, and uploads in order on reconnect. The server flags any pass scanned twice for one sailing.

facets.label: Done when
facets.markdown: `scanner-sim --replay-duplicates testdata/copied-passes.json` flags both copies after the reconnect.

facets.label: Note
facets.markdown: A copy used on two handhelds on one sailing is only caught after upload. The harbour office agreed that is acceptable at Brisk.

items.title: Trial on the Brisk crossings for a week
items.summary: Every Brisk crossing boards from the scanner for a week, with the paper list printed as a fallback.

facets.label: What changes
facets.markdown: For one week, crew scan every pass at the Brisk slipway and tick the paper list only when a scan fails. Ines logs every failure with its reason.

facets.label: Done when
facets.markdown: Fewer than one scan in a hundred falls back to the paper list, and no rider waits more than a minute at the ramp.

items.title: Retire the printed boarding list
items.summary: Stop printing the list the night before, once the harbour authority signs off on boarding from the scanner alone.

facets.label: What changes
facets.markdown: The nightly print job stops for Brisk, and the crew app keeps a read-only list for emergencies.

facets.label: Done when
facets.markdown: The harbour authority confirms in writing that scanner-only boarding meets its passenger count rules.

facets.label: Risk
facets.markdown: The authority wants a passenger count that survives a flat battery. Until it rules, each boat carries a charged spare handheld.

parts.markdown: The plan has worked when a full week of Brisk crossings boards from the scanner alone, and a copied pass is caught in the simulator and in the trial.

parts.title: Checks
parts.code:
go test ./booking/pass/... ./scanner/...
scanner-sim --offline 8h --passes testdata/brisk-week.json
scanner-sim --replay-duplicates testdata/copied-passes.json
